inspectedPhotos.observations: Clear full-height three-quarter view: inset glazed corner strips, narrow vertical granite mullions, dark spandrels, open colonnaded band below four projecting glazed upper corner volumes, narrower central cap with paired horizontal louvers and a ringed beacon mast. Base partly hidden by trees.
inspectedPhotos.detailInspection: Native-resolution top view visually corroborates14narrow main window bays and7opencolonnadebays. Windows have broad dark lower spandrels. Beacon has cylindrical base, three projecting horizontal rings, mesh-textured upper cylinder and needle tip. Offset white roof maintenance crane extends past the roof. Central front of the top cap has6narrowwindows and3double-width upper louver bays. Fine glazed-corner volumes have finer vertical subdivisions.
